title: Technology Sector Update for 12/18/2018: NXPI,NOK,MRIN,GOOG,GOOGL,DPW
text:

Technology stocks were firming in recent trading, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding 1.1% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising 2.2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Marin Software ( MRIN ) surged almost 95% at one point during Tuesday trading after raising its forecast for Q4 revenue by $3 million to a new range of $14.6 million to $15.1 million and slashing its projected non-GAAP net loss by $3 million to between $2.9 million to $2.5 million to reflect the impact of its new, three-year revenue sharing agreement with Google (GOOG,GOOGL) to further develop Marin's enterprise technology platform and software products.
In other sector news:
(+) NXP Semiconductors NV ( NXPI ) was posting a more than 2% gain. The chipmaker, together with cellular telephone specialists Nokia ( NOK ), said it received a CATRENE innovation award from the AENEAS trade group for its work advancing the rollout of 5G mobile communication networks.
(-) DPW Holdings ( DPW ) was down 16% on Tuesday after the electronic components manufacturer said its board of directors has approved the proposed spinoff of its DPW Technology Group, with the defense and aerospace contractor becoming a stand-alone publicy traded company.
